features.title: Special Offensive encounter scoring profile
features.gap: Existing encounter scoring has Balanced and TechniqueFirst modes only.
features.adaptation: Opt-in score-attack evaluation inside the existing EncounterChallengeTracker.
features.acceptance: Legacy modes remain unchanged and SpecialOffensive uses existing encounter ownership.

features.title: Active mixed-technique combo scoring
features.gap: CombatSandbox tracks an authoritative technique chain but encounter scoring did not expose it.
features.adaptation: Bounded score-only bonus from the existing active mixed-technique chain, maximum four.
features.acceptance: Expired or pre-activation chain state cannot inflate the accepted encounter score.

features.title: Selectable tactical score protocols
features.gap: Tactical focus chooses a side-goal event but no separate score protocol exists.
features.adaptation: Original ShadowTempo, RiftPressure and BalancedFlow score-only protocols.
features.acceptance: Protocols never alter health, damage, enemy state, rewards or persistent progression.

features.title: Explicit score breakdown and time coefficient
features.gap: Challenge result exposed an aggregate total rather than individual score axes.
features.adaptation: Expose damage, technique, combo, protocol bonus, time coefficient, pre-difficulty and final score.
features.acceptance: Breakdown is deterministic, activation-local and uses bounded arithmetic.

features.title: Per-difficulty personal best retention
features.gap: Tracker retains first-clear reward state but not a score-chase record.
features.adaptation: Retain only a strictly higher positive SpecialOffensive score per difficulty across retries.
features.acceptance: Worse replays cannot lower or duplicate the retained best.

features.title: Read-only weakest-axis score coach
features.current_resolution: Current 2026-09-14 official Shadow Chase rules explicitly name more score components, so older criticism is treated as a historical player preference rather than proof of a current ZZZ defect.
features.gap: Astral challenge totals do not explain which execution axis most limited a run.
features.adaptation: Report Damage, Technique, Combo, Time or None from accepted score evidence without mutating gameplay.
features.acceptance: Coach output is deterministic and read-only.
